Build an app called FieldNotesApp.

This is the full product brief. The app is a work-safe, local-only IT incident logger for fast support notes. It is intended for one user: an IT support worker/technician who needs to quickly capture what happened during calls, walk-ups, classroom issues, client visits, informal fixes, or troubleshooting sessions, then copy the note into HaloPSA, an email, a handover note, or a client/job record.

Do not build a landing page first. Build the actual usable app.

PRODUCT SHAPE

App name:
FieldNotesApp

Primary user:
Single IT support worker / technician.

Use contexts:
- Avance IT / MSP support
- Dubbo Christian School / school ICT
- Parris Tech Services / small business IT support
- Personal lab/testing notes

Primary purpose:
Capture structured IT incident notes quickly and safely.

This is not:
- a team ticketing system
- a client portal
- a mental health app
- a job tracker
- an admin-managed app
- a public SaaS product
- an AI app

V1 SCOPE

Single-user only.
No accounts.
No login.
No backend.
No database server.
No cloud sync.
No admin panel.
No client/student data required.
No AI.
No photos in v1.
No file uploads in v1.
No GPS/geolocation in v1.
No audio recording storage in v1.

Voice-to-text:
Include a simple optional voice-to-text/microphone button if browser SpeechRecognition/webkitSpeechRecognition is available. It should insert dictated text into the active field. It must not store audio recordings. If unsupported, hide or disable the mic button gracefully.

Persistence:
Use local browser storage only. Prefer localStorage for this MVP. IndexedDB is acceptable only if it is already used in the project and does not add complexity.

Default stack:
Keep this simple. Use plain HTML, CSS, and vanilla JavaScript if the repo is blank or simple.
If the existing repository already uses React/Vite/Next, adapt to the existing stack with minimal new dependencies.
Do not add a backend or authentication.

CORE DATA MODEL

Each field note should contain:

Required fields:
- id
- createdAt timestamp, auto-generated
- updatedAt timestamp
- context: Avance / DCS / PTS / Personal Lab / Other
- title or short issue summary
- issue: what happened / user-reported problem
- checks: what I checked or tested
- changes: what I changed or tried
- result: what happened after testing/changing
- followUp: what still needs follow-up or watching

Optional fields:
- category: Account / Email / OneDrive / Printer / Network / Wi-Fi / Device / AV / Security / Medical Objects / Backup / Other
- priority: Low / Normal / High / Urgent
- status: Draft / Complete / Needs Follow-up
- manualLocation: room, site, client, device, or general location typed manually
- tags: comma-separated or chip-style tags
- copiedAt timestamp, updated when copied to clipboard

Privacy/safety:
Add a visible local-only privacy note somewhere in the app:
“Local-only: notes are saved in this browser. Avoid storing passwords, student details, client secrets, or sensitive personal information.”

CORE SCREENS / VIEWS

1. Note list / dashboard

Show:
- search box
- filters for context, category, status, and priority
- list of saved notes, newest first
- each note card shows title, context, category, status, priority, created date/time, and a short preview
- buttons: New Note, Export All, Clear Demo/All Data with confirmation

2. Create/edit note form

Fields:
- Context
- Title / Issue Summary
- Category
- Priority
- Status
- Manual Location / Site / Room / Device
- Issue: what happened
- Checks: what I checked/tested
- Changes: what I changed/tried
- Result
- Follow-up needed
- Tags

Buttons:
- Save Draft
- Mark Complete
- Copy Ticket Note
- Delete, with confirmation
- Back to list

The form should be fast and practical on mobile.

3. Detail view

Show the completed field note in a clean professional format.

Include:
- Edit
- Copy Ticket Note
- Copy Client Summary
- Duplicate Note
- Delete

COPY/EXPORT FORMATS

Copy Ticket Note should generate a clean structured text block like this:

FIELD NOTE
Context: [context]
Category: [category]
Priority: [priority]
Status: [status]
Created: [date/time]

Issue:
[issue]

Checks performed:
[checks]

Changes / actions taken:
[changes]

Result:
[result]

Follow-up / watch items:
[followUp]

Tags:
[tags]

Copy Client Summary should generate a shorter version:

Summary:
[plain-English issue and result]

Action taken:
[changes]

Follow-up:
[followUp]

Export All:
Export all saved notes as a downloadable .txt or .json file. Keep it simple. Text export is enough for v1.

SEARCH AND FILTERING

Search should match:
- title
- issue
- checks
- changes
- result
- follow-up
- tags
- manual location

Filters:
- context
- category
- status
- priority

Sorting:
Newest first by default.

DESIGN REQUIREMENTS

Style:
Professional, calm, work-safe, not playful.

Visual feel:
- clean cards
- strong readability
- mobile-first
- works well on desktop
- no gimmicks
- no game UI
- no therapy/wellbeing language

Suggested palette:
- dark navy / charcoal for headers
- white or very light grey backgrounds
- muted blue or teal accent
- subtle status colours only

Accessibility:
- keyboard usable
- labels for every form field
- sufficient contrast
- buttons clearly named
- avoid tiny tap targets on mobile

IMPORTANT UX DETAILS

The app should feel like it was built for real IT support work.

It should support quick note-taking during:
- phone calls
- walk-up support
- server/network troubleshooting
- classroom AV issues
- client visits
- informal verbal jobs
- handover documentation

Avoid overbuilding. No charts, no analytics dashboard, no team features, no cloud features, no role permissions.

SUGGESTED FILE STRUCTURE FOR VANILLA VERSION

If building vanilla JS, use:

/index.html
/src/styles.css
/src/app.js
/src/storage.js
/src/formatters.js
/src/sampleData.js

Or keep it even simpler if the existing project structure requires it.

SAMPLE DATA

Add 3 sample/demo notes only if helpful:

1. OneDrive sync issue
Context: Avance
Category: OneDrive
Priority: Normal

2. ViewBoard not displaying laptop
Context: DCS
Category: AV
Priority: High

3. Printer offline at client site
Context: PTS
Category: Printer
Priority: Normal

Make demo data easy to remove.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA

The app is complete when:

- I can create a note
- I can edit a note
- I can delete a note
- I can search notes
- I can filter notes
- notes persist after refresh
- I can copy a structured ticket note to clipboard
- I can copy a shorter client summary to clipboard
- I can export all notes
- the app works on mobile-width screens
- there is a local-only privacy warning
- there are no backend/auth/cloud dependencies
- no sensitive sample data is included
- the app runs locally without errors

TESTING

After implementation:
- run the project locally
- fix any build/runtime errors
- test create/edit/delete/search/filter/copy/export
- check mobile layout in browser responsive mode
- report what was built, what files changed, and how to run it

FINAL OUTPUT

After building, provide:
1. Summary of implementation
2. Files changed
3. How to run locally
4. Known limitations
5. Suggested next steps for v2

V2 IDEAS — DO NOT BUILD NOW

Do not build these in v1, but keep the structure clean enough that they could be added later:
- daily work log
- weekly summary
- PDF export
- field note templates
- import/export backup
- JoshHub integration
- ParrisTechServicesApp integration
- Traceability Engine reporting layer
- MSP Quest training integration
